summary: Iteration 9 REGRESSION pass after code-quality (safe) fixes. Backend: ran the whole /app/backend/tests suite with -n0 -> 115 passed / 4 failed (96.6%). All requested suites pass 100%: backend_test.py (env-loaded ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD auth works, no hardcoded secret), test_iter6_live_api.py, test_iter7_config_persist.py, test_iter8_multiaccount.py (multi-account CRUD, plan limits, X-Account-Id isolation). Frontend: admin@fishit.app and user@fishit.app both log in and reach the dashboard; every page (Status, Telegram, Konfigurasi, Activity Log, Notifikasi, Paket, Kelola User) renders with ZERO console errors/warnings and zero page errors. Verified: account switcher lists accounts (admin 1/3, user 2/3) and add button shows correct plan label '+ Tambah akun (Elite)'; Config save persists per account after reload (admin and user); Activity Log loads + filter input + manual refresh work; Admin page loads 43 users + 4 stat cards and role/plan selects + active toggle all persist (toggle aktif->disabled->aktif, role user->admin); Notifications (seeded 2 unread) show unread badge in sidebar + page, single mark-read decrements, mark-all-read persists after reload; Landing page renders. No functional regressions found from the code-quality fixes.

minor.issue: tests/test_iter5_boost_filter.py::test_get_config_defaults asserts default boost_trigger_pattern contains 'PERAHU SIAP BERANGKAT' but the product default is now '(AUTO MANCING DIMULAI)'. Stale assertion, not a product bug — main agent should confirm the intended default and update the assertion.

tests/test_bugfixes_iter2.py::test_cycle_group_passes_extend_on_active and test_iter5_boost_filter.py::test_cycle_group_pattern_is_pendaftaran_dibuka do inspect.getsource() string matching on AutomationRunner._cycle_group; the engine was refactored so the strings moved. Brittle source-introspection tests — should be rewritten or dropped.

tests/test_bugfixes_iter3.py::test_handle_verification_tries_webview_before_pause fails because _handle_verification now performs the plan-gating manual-verify pause() (Starter plans) BEFORE the webview attempt. Code reviewed: this is intentional plan gating, not a regression; the source-order assertion is stale.

critical_code_review_comments: Notifications are account-scoped by the composite key 'user_id:account_id' (automation_routes.py) but tests/test_iter4 seeded them with the plain user_id — I fixed the test. Worth documenting the composite key convention, as any future seed/migration writing plain user_id will silently produce invisible records.
get_account_key() still silently falls back to the default account for an unknown/foreign X-Account-Id (carried over from iteration 8) — consider 404 instead of silent fallback.
Prefer resolving REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in tests from /app/frontend/.env rather than hardcoded preview hostnames (was pointing to a dead host in 3 files).
